paragraphs.text: Rionya , known as the Fire Dancer , is a human wizard enrolled at the Prismari College within Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios .

At Prismari, students have the freedom to pursue their creative projects individually or as part of a group. Rionya, however, took a unique approach by combining both methods simultaneously. She prefers not to spend time explaining her artistic vision to others, choosing instead to collaborate with one partner who can flawlessly follow her lead and match her movements perfectly—herself.
